confidence_notes: Food estimates use recent Palawan aggregated prices and Coron travel guides; the regional sample is small, and tourist-facing prices vary. Cocktail and wine estimates use their likely price relationship to local beer because direct typical prices are sparse. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates with substantial July and property-level variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Palawan-wide restaurant prices as a regional check alongside Coron town meal and beer ranges. Accommodation estimates reflect Coron as a seasonal island tourism hub.
